remarks: Waterfront 2 Bedroom, 1 Bath right on Harbor Road... One of the most sought after locations in Westport. This super cute home oozes New England character and charm. Water access right out of the front door and views of the Long Island Sound from just about every room in the house. Be part of the Saugatuck Shores community. Enjoy access to beautiful Compo Beach, Longshore Park and award winning Westport Schools. Close to Metro North train and I-95 for easy commuting. Kayak to Cockenoe Island, right up the Saugatuck river into town or grab a drink at the famed Black Duck. This is a water-lover's dream. Home boasts new Pella windows throughout which will keep your heating and cooling bills low as well as your spectacular view, crystal clear. Recently paved 2 car driveway and 1 car garage. Bathroom is partially renovated and there is fresh paint throughout. There is newer carpet on the second level. 3rd room upstairs can be an office, a nursery or even a small 3rd bedroom. Both bedrooms feature large walk-in closets. Enclosed heated porch provides an additional 120 square and can be enjoyed year-round. Welcome to Saugatuck Shores!
